title: Aurai Modpack
description: This Minecraft modpack optimizes performance and enhances the game's appeal while maintaining a vanilla-style experience, with a few subtle additions to improve gameplay.
body:
## Aurai Modpack

**Optimization and Enhanced Vanilla Experience**

This Minecraft modpack focuses on optimization and visual improvements while maintaining the classic vanilla feel.

It includes the **Essential** mod, offering additional features like social tools and multiplayer options.

Among the visual mods, some add new animations, such as **Not Enough Animations**, bringing more life and immersion to the game.

_With subtle enhancements that blend naturally with the original game, this modpack ensures smoother performance and an enriched gameplay experience._
